						v_u_18:Open("Booth")
					end
					p79:OpenView("CreateListing")
					v_u_78 = {
						v82,
						v80,
						1,
						v81
					}
				else
					v_u_26:SendNotification("Max listing reached! Please delete a listing before creating a new one!")
					v_u_5.Misc.error:Play()
				end
			else
				return
			end
		else
			return
		end
	else
		return
	end
end

local function v_u_129(p116) -- name: timeAgo
	local v117 = p116 / 60
	local v118 = math.floor(v117)
	local v119 = v118 / 60
	local v120 = math.floor(v119)
	local v121 = v120 / 24
	local v122 = math.floor(v121)
	local v123 = v122 / 7
	local v124 = math.floor(v123)
	local v125 = v122 / 30
	local v126 = math.floor(v125)
	local v127 = v122 / 365
	local v128 = math.floor(v127)
	if p116 < 60 then
		return "just now"
	elseif v118 < 60 then
		return v118 .. " minute(s) ago"
	elseif v120 < 24 then
		return v120 .. " hour(s) ago"
	elseif v122 == 1 then
		return "yesterday"
	elseif v122 < 7 then
		return v122 .. " day(s) ago"
	elseif v124 == 1 then
		return "a week ago"
	elseif v124 < 4 then
		return v124 .. " week(s) ago"
	elseif v126 == 1 then
		return "a month ago"
	elseif v126 < 12 then
		return v126 .. " month(s) ago"
	else
		return v128 == 1 and "a year ago" or v128 .. " year(s) ago"
	end
end

local function v_u_42(p33) -- name: formatOfflineTime
	local v34 = workspace:GetServerTimeNow() - p33
	if v34 >= 86400 then
		local v35 = v34 / 86400
		return ("%* DAY(S) AGO"):format((math.ceil(v35)))
	end
	if v34 >= 3600 then
		local v36 = v34 / 3600
		local v37 = math.ceil(v36)
		return ("%* HOUR%* AGO"):format(v37, v37 > 1 and "S" or "")
	end
	if v34 < 60 then
		local v38 = math.round(v34)
		return ("%* SECOND%* AGO"):format(v38, math.round(v38) > 1 and "S" or "")
	end
	local v39 = v34 / 60
	local v40 = math.ceil(v39)
	local v41 = math.max(1, v40)
	return ("%* MINUTE%* AGO"):format(v41, v41 > 1 and "S" or "")
end
function v32.ManageMember(_, p_u_43) -- name: ManageMember
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_9, (copy) v_u_8, (copy) v_u_14, (copy) v_u_23, (copy) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_5, (copy) v_u_22, (copy) v_u_15, (copy) v_u_27, (copy) v_u_16, (copy) v_u_28, (copy) v_u_10, (copy) v_u_6
	if v_u_9:IsOpen("ManageMember") then
		return
	else
		local v44 = v_u_8.ClanReplion
		if v44 then
			local v45 = v44.Data.Info
			local v46 = v_u_14.getRank(v_u_23, v45)
			local v47 = v_u_14.hasPermissionFor(v_u_23, "KICK_MEMBERS", v45)

				local v49 = v45.members
				if table.find(v49, p_u_43) and v_u_11.getFormattedUserId(v_u_23) ~= p_u_43 then
					local v50 = table.find(v_u_14.Ranks, v46) or 1
					local v51 = v_u_14.getRank(p_u_43, v45)
					local v52 = table.find(v_u_14.Ranks, v51) or 1
					if v50 <= v52 then
						v_u_5.Misc.error:Play()
					else
						local v_u_53 = v_u_14.Ranks[v52 + 1]
						local v_u_54 = v_u_14.Ranks[v52 - 1]
						local v55
						if v_u_53 then
							if v_u_53 == "Owner" then
								v55 = false
							else
								v55 = v48
							end
						else
							v55 = v_u_53
						end
						if v_u_54 == nil then
							v48 = false
						end
						v_u_22:AddPromise(v_u_15:GetUser((v_u_11.parseUserId(p_u_43)))):andThen(function(p56)
							-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_27, (ref) v_u_16
							if typeof(p56) == "Instance" and p56:IsA("Player") then
								v_u_27.Username.Text = ("%*"):format((v_u_16:GetHumanoidName(p56, false)))
							else
								v_u_27.Username.Text = ("%*"):format((v_u_16:GetUserName(p56)))
							end
						end):catch(function()
							-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_27
							v_u_27.Username.Text = "[Failed to load]"
						end)
						v_u_28.Promote.Visible = v55
						v_u_28.Demote.Visible = v48
						v_u_28.Kick.Visible = v47
						v_u_22:Add(v_u_27.Close.Activated:Connect(function()
							-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_9
							v_u_9:RemovePage("ManageMember")
						end))
						if v48 then
							v_u_22:Add(v_u_28.Demote.Activated:Connect(function()
								-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_10, (ref) v_u_6, (copy) p_u_43, (copy) v_u_54, (ref) v_u_5, (ref) v_u_9
								if v_u_10:Prompt({
									["title"] = "DEMOTE MEMBER",
									["text"] = "Are you sure you want to demote this member?",
									["returnTo"] = "Overview"
								}) then
									if not v_u_6:Invoke("ClanUpdatePlayerRank", p_u_43, v_u_54) then
										v_u_5.Misc.error:Play()
									end
									v_u_9:RemovePage("ManageMember")
								end
							end))
						end
						if v55 then
							v_u_22:Add(v_u_28.Promote.Activated:Connect(function()
								-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_10, (ref) v_u_6, (copy) p_u_43, (copy) v_u_53, (ref) v_u_5, (ref) v_u_9
								if v_u_10:Prompt({
									["title"] = "PROMOTE MEMBER",
									["text"] = "Are you sure you want to promote this member?",
									["returnTo"] = "Overview"
								}) then
									if not v_u_6:Invoke("ClanUpdatePlayerRank", p_u_43, v_u_53) then
										v_u_5.Misc.error:Play()
									end
									v_u_9:RemovePage("ManageMember")
								end
							end))
						end
						if v47 then
							v_u_22:Add(v_u_28.Kick.Activated:Connect(function()
								-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_10, (ref) v_u_6, (copy) p_u_43, (ref) v_u_5
								if v_u_10:Prompt({
									["title"] = "KICK MEMBER",
									["text"] = "Are you sure you want to kick this member?",
									["returnTo"] = "Overview"
								}) then
									if not v_u_6:Invoke("ClanKickPlayer", p_u_43) then
										v_u_5.Misc.error:Play()
									end
								end
							end))
						end
						v_u_9:PushPage("ManageMember")
					end
				else
					return
				end
			else
				return
			end
		else
			return
		end
	end
end
function v32.RenderMembers(p_u_57, p_u_58) -- name: RenderMembers
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_14, (copy) v_u_31, (copy) v_u_9, (copy) v_u_15, (copy) v_u_16, (copy) v_u_23, (copy) v_u_20, (copy) v_u_42, (copy) v_u_12
	local v59 = table.clone(p_u_58.clanInfo.members)
	local v60 = p_u_58.clanInfo.clanContributions or {}
	local v61 = p_u_58.clanInfo.clanMemberStatuses or {}
	local v_u_62 = {}
	if v61 then
		for _, v63 in v61 do
			local v64 = string.split(v63, ":")
			local v65 = v64[1]
			v_u_62[v65] = {}
			table.remove(v64, 1)
			for _, v66 in v64 do
				local v67 = string.split(v66, "/")

					if v67[2] == "false" then

		end
	end
	if p_u_58.sortOrder == "Status" then
		table.sort(v59, function(p71, p72)
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_11, (ref) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_62, (ref) v_u_14, (copy) p_u_58
			local v73 = v_u_11.parseUserId(p71)
			local v74 = v_u_11.parseUserId(p72)
			local v75 = v_u_4:GetPlayerByUserId(v73)
			local v76 = v_u_4:GetPlayerByUserId(v74)
			if v75 and not v76 then
				return true
			end
			if not v75 and v76 then
				return false
			end
			local v77 = v_u_62[v73]
			local v78 = v_u_62[v74]
			local v79
			if v77 then
				v79 = v77.Online
			else
				v79 = false
			end
			local v80 = not v77 and 0 or v77.LastOnline
			local v81
			if v78 then
				v81 = v78.Online
			else
				v81 = false
			end
			local v82 = not v78 and 0 or v78.LastOnline
			if v79 ~= v81 then
				if v79 then
					v79 = not v81
				end
				return v79
			end
			if v80 and v82 then
				return v82 < v80
			end
			local v83 = v_u_14.getRank(p71, p_u_58.clanInfo)
			local v84 = v_u_14.getRank(p72, p_u_58.clanInfo)
			return (table.find(v_u_14.Ranks, v83) or 1) > (table.find(v_u_14.Ranks, v84) or 1)
		end)
	elseif p_u_58.sortOrder == "Rank" then
		local _ = p_u_58.clanInfo.ranks
		table.sort(v59, function(p85, p86)
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_14, (copy) p_u_58
			local v87 = v_u_14.getRank(p85, p_u_58.clanInfo)
			local v88 = v_u_14.getRank(p86, p_u_58.clanInfo)
			return (table.find(v_u_14.Ranks, v87) or 1) > (table.find(v_u_14.Ranks, v88) or 1)
		end)
	end
	local v89 = p_u_58.cache
	if v89 then
		local v90 = #v89 - #v59
		if v90 > 0 then
			for v91 = #v89, #v89 - v90 + 1, -1 do
				local v92 = v89[v91]
				if not v92 then
					continue
				end
				v92.Visible = false
			end
		end
	end

		if not v_u_99 then

				v_u_99 = p_u_58.trove:Clone(v95)
			else
				v_u_99 = v95:Clone()
			end
			v_u_99.Name = v98
			v_u_99.Visible = true

			v_u_99.Selectable = p_u_58.viewOnly ~= true
			if p_u_58.onCreated then

			end
			v_u_99.Parent = v94
			if not p_u_58.viewOnly and v_u_99:IsA("GuiButton") then
				v_u_99.Activated:Connect(function()
					-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_9, (copy) p_u_57, (copy) v_u_99
					if v_u_9:IsLastPage("Overview") then
						p_u_57:ManageMember(v_u_99.Name)
					end
				end)
			end
			if p_u_58.cache then
				p_u_58.cache[v97] = v_u_99
			end
		end
		local v100 = v_u_14.getRank(v98, p_u_58.clanInfo)
		local v101 = v_u_11.parseUserId(v98)
		local v102 = tonumber(v101)
		v_u_99.Name = v98
		v_u_99.PlayerHeadshot.Image = ("rbxthumb://type=AvatarHeadShot&id=%*&w=100&h=100"):format(v101)

		else
			p_u_58.trove:AddPromise(v_u_15:GetUser(v101)):andThen(function(p103)
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_99, (ref) v_u_16

				end

		end

		local v110 = v_u_99:FindFirstChild("Amount")

function v32.UpdateLevel(_, p114) -- name: UpdateLevel

	local v116 = p114:Get("Info.clanXp") or 0
	local v117 = v_u_13.ClanLevels[v115 + 1]

	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_21, (copy) v_u_18, (ref) v_u_142, (copy) v_u_17, (copy) v_u_22
	local v146 = v_u_21.getInstance("Swords", p_u_144)

local function v_u_184(p165) -- name: updateRigSword
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_142, (copy) v_u_20, (copy) v_u_16, (copy) v_u_163, (copy) v_u_18, (ref) v_u_164, (copy) v_u_40, (copy) v_u_19, (copy) v_u_8

		v167 = v166

			local v168 = v_u_20:GetInstance(v166)

				end

			end
		else

			v166 = nil
		end
		if v166 then
			v_u_163(p165, v166, 1)
		end
	end
	local v173 = p165:GetAttribute("Slash") and (v167 and v_u_18:GetSword(v167))
	if v173 then
		v_u_164:Clean()
		local v174 = v173.AnimationType or "SlashEffect"
		print("play", v174)
		v_u_40:SetAttribute("ServerParryCount", (v_u_40:GetAttribute("ServerParryCount") or 0) + 1)
		local v175 = { "Parry", "SuccessParry" }
		local v176 = v_u_19:GetSuccessParryVariantCount(p165, v173.AnimationType, v173.SwordType)
		if v176 then
			v175[2] = ("SuccessParry%*"):format((v_u_40:GetAttribute("ServerParryCount") or 0) % v176 + 1)
		end
		local v177 = v_u_19:GetAnimations(p165, v175, v173.AnimationType, v173.SwordType)
		local v178 = table.create(#v177)

			v181.Looped = false
			v178[v179] = v181
		end
		for _, v182 in v178 do
			v182:Play(0)
		end
		local v183 = p165:FindFirstChild("SlashOrigin") or p165.Torso
		v_u_8.Remotes.ParrySuccessClient:Fire(v_u_19:GetSlashName(v167, v173.SlashName), v183, v167)
	end

	local v136 = v_u_6:GetLastInputType()
	local v137 = v_u_15.Keybinds[p135].Default
	return string.find(v136.Name, "Gamepad") and v137.Console or v137.PC
end
function v_u_73.GetBinds(_, p138) -- name: GetBinds
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_68, (copy) v_u_6, (copy) v_u_8
	debug.profilebegin("SettingsController:GetBinds")
	if v_u_68 then
		local v139 = v_u_6:GetLastInputType()
		local v140 = v_u_68.Data.Settings
		if v140 then
			local v141 = v140.Keybinds[p138]
			if v141 then
				if v139 == Enum.UserInputType.Focus then
					debug.profileend()
					if #v_u_6:GetConnectedGamepads() >= 1 or v_u_8:IsTenFootInterface() then
						return v141.Console
					else
						return v141.PC
					end
				else
					debug.profileend()
					return string.find(v139.Name, "Gamepad") and v141.Console or v141.PC
				end
			else
				debug.profileend()
				return
			end
		else
			debug.profileend()
			return
		end
	else
		debug.profileend()
		return
	end
end
function v_u_73.BindConnection(_, p_u_142, p_u_143, p_u_144) -- name: BindConnection
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_74, (copy) v_u_6, (ref) v_u_110, (copy) v_u_125
	if v_u_74 then
		v_u_74:Disconnect()
	end
	p_u_144.Parent.Active = false
	task.wait()
	v_u_74 = v_u_6.InputBegan:Connect(function(p145, _)
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_110, (copy) p_u_142, (copy) p_u_143, (ref) v_u_125, (ref) v_u_74, (copy) p_u_144
		if p145.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
			v_u_110:FireServer("PC", p_u_142, p_u_143, p145.KeyCode.Name)
		elseif v_u_125[p145.UserInputType.Name] then
			v_u_110:FireServer("PC", p_u_142, p_u_143, p145.UserInputType.Name)
		end
		if v_u_74 then
			v_u_74:Disconnect()
			p_u_144.Parent.Active = true
		end
	end)
end

local v_u_179 = setmetatable({}, {
	["__mode"] = "k"
})
function v_u_73.SetType(_, p180) -- name: SetType
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_179
	if v_u_179[p180] == nil then
		local v181 = p180.ClassName
		if p180:IsA("BasePart") and p180.Material ~= Enum.Material.Neon then
			v_u_179[p180] = p180.Material.Name
			return
		elseif v181 == "ParticleEmitter" or v181 == "Trail" then
			v_u_179[p180] = p180.Lifetime
		elseif v181 == "Beam" then
			v_u_179[p180] = p180.Transparency
		end
	else
		return
	end
end
local v_u_182 = NumberSequence.new(1)
function v_u_73.UpdateObject(p183, p184, p185) -- name: UpdateObject
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_68, (copy) v_u_73, (copy) v_u_179, (ref) v_u_122, (copy) v_u_182
	debug.profilebegin("SettingsController.UpdateObject")
	if p183:GetAttribute("IgnoreLowGraphics") then
		debug.profileend()
		return
	elseif v_u_68 then
		v_u_73:SetType(p183)
		local v186 = v_u_179[p183]
		if v186 == nil then
			debug.profileend()
		else
			local v187 = p183.ClassName
			if p183:IsA("BasePart") and p183.Material ~= Enum.Material.Neon then
				if v186 == nil then
					debug.profileend()
					return
				end
				local v188
				if v_u_122 then
					v188 = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
				else
					v188 = Enum.Material[v186]
				end
				p183.Material = v188
			elseif v187 == "ParticleEmitter" or v187 == "Trail" then
				if v186 == nil then
					debug.profileend()
					return
				end
				if v_u_122 and not p185 or p184 then
					p183.Lifetime = v187 == "Trail" and 0 or NumberRange.new(0)
					if v187 == "ParticleEmitter" then
						p183:Clear()
					end
				else
					p183.Lifetime = v186
				end
			elseif v187 == "Beam" then
				if v_u_122 and not p185 or p184 then
					p183.Transparency = v_u_182
				else
					p183.Transparency = v186
				end
			end
			debug.profileend()
		end
	else
		debug.profileend()
		return
	end
end

function v_u_73.ResetSettingsToDefault() -- name: ResetSettingsToDefault
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_15, (ref) v_u_88, (ref) v_u_110, (ref) v_u_109, (ref) v_u_89, (ref) v_u_90, (ref) v_u_91, (ref) v_u_72

			continue
		end

		if typeof(v307) ~= "table" then
			continue
		end
		v_u_110:FireServer("PC", "Reset", v306, v307.Default.PC)
		v_u_110:FireServer("Console", "Reset", v306, v307.Default.Console)
	end
	for v308, v309 in v_u_15.Accessibility do

		end
		v_u_109:FireServer("Accessibility", v308, nil)
	end
	for v310, v311 in v_u_15.Misc do
		if typeof(v311) ~= "table" or (not v311.Validate or v311.ResetIgnore) then
			continue
		end
		local v312 = string.match(v310, "^(.+)ButtonPosition$")
		local v313 = string.match(v310, "^(.+)ButtonScale$")

			v_u_89:FireServer(v312, v311.Default)

		elseif v311.Max == nil then

		else
			v_u_88:FireServer(v310, v311.Default)
		end
	end
end

	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_129, (copy) v_u_27, (copy) v_u_7

	if not v132 then
		v132 = {}

		return v132[p131]
	end
	local v_u_133 = v_u_27.State(false)
	v132[p131] = v_u_133
	local v_u_134 = v_u_7.Client:WaitReplion("Data")
	local v_u_135 = { "IndexFavorites", p130, p131 }
	v_u_133:Set(v_u_134:Get(v_u_135) and true or false)
	v_u_134:OnChange(v_u_135, function() -- name: updateFavorited
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_133, (copy) v_u_134, (copy) v_u_135

function v61.GetFakeCaller(_, p136, p137) -- name: GetFakeCaller
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_21, (copy) v_u_22, (copy) v_u_8, (copy) v_u_23, (copy) v_u_26
	local v138 = {}
	local v139 = {}
	local v140 = {}
	for _, v141 in v_u_21.InventoryTypes do
		v138[v141] = {}
		local v142 = v_u_22[v141]
		local v143
		if p137 then
			v143 = p137[v141]
		else
			v143 = p137
		end
		if type(v142) == "table" then
			for _, v144 in v142 do
				if v143 and not table.find(v143, v144) then
					continue
				end
				v138[v141][v144] = {
					["Name"] = v144
				}
			end
			v140[v141] = v_u_8.List.map(v142, function(p145, p146)
				return {
					["Name"] = p145,
					["Id"] = p145
				}, p146
			end)
		else
			if not v143 or table.find(v143, v142) then
				v138[v141][v142] = {
					["Name"] = v142
				}
			end
			v139[v141] = {
				["Name"] = v142,
				["Id"] = v142
			}
		end
	end
	for _, v147 in pairs(p136 or v_u_23.TradableItemTypes) do
		local v148 = v_u_26[v147]
		local v149
		if p137 then
			v149 = p137[v147]
		else
			v149 = p137
		end
		for _, v150 in v148 do
			if not v150.Name or v149 and not table.find(v149, v150.Name) then
				continue
			end
			v138[v147][v150.Name] = {
				["Name"] = v150.Name
			}
			if v147 == "Sword" and v150.HasFinisher then
				v138[v147][v150.Name .. "_Finisher"] = {
					["Name"] = nil,
					["Finisher"] = true,
					["Name"] = v150.Name
				}
			end
			if v147 ~= "Sword" or not v150.AccessoryUnlockable then
				continue
			end
			v138[v147][v150.Name .. "_Accessory"] = {
				["Name"] = nil,
				["Accessory"] = true,
				["Name"] = v150.Name
			}
		end
	end
	return {
		["Type"] = "FakeCaller",
		["CustomType"] = "Index",
		["Replion"] = nil,
		["Replion"] = v_u_21:CreateFakeReplion({
			["Tokens"] = 0,
			["Inventory"] = nil,
			["Equipped"] = nil,
			["EquippedList"] = nil,
			["Inventory"] = v138,
			["Equipped"] = v139,
			["EquippedList"] = v140
		})
	}
end

function v53.CanTrade(_) -- name: CanTrade
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_15, (copy) v_u_9, (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_24, (copy) v_u_17, (copy) v_u_6
	if v_u_15.FFlag.GetInstantFFlag("TradingEnabled") == true and v_u_15.FFlag.GetInstantFFlag("TradingSystemEnabled") == true then
		local v99 = v_u_9.Client:GetReplion("Data")
		if v99 then
			local v100 = v99:Get("TradeLockedUntil")
			local v101 = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
			if v99:Get("TradeBanned") then
				return false, "You are unable to trade!"
			elseif v100 and (v100 > 0 and v101 < v100) then
				local v102 = v100 - v101
				return false, ("You are unable to trade for %*"):format((v_u_15.ValueConvertor:FormatShortTime(v102)))
			elseif (v99:Get("TotalStats.Wins") or 0) < 1 and not v_u_7:IsStudio() then
				return false, "You can\'t trade before getting 1 Win!"
			elseif v_u_24:GetAttribute("__globalUpdatesInitialized") then
				local v103 = DateTime.now().UnixTimestamp
				local v104 = v103 - (v_u_24:GetAttribute("JoinedTimestamp") or v99:Get("LastSession") or v103)
				local v105 = v_u_15.FFlag.GetInstantFFlag("TradeJoinCooldown", 30)
				if v104 < v105 and not v_u_7:IsStudio() then
					local v106 = v105 - v104
					return false, ("You can\'t trade for %* seconds!"):format((math.ceil(v106)))
				else
					local v107, v108 = v_u_17.retryWithDelay(v_u_6.GetPolicyInfoForPlayerAsync, 3, 2, v_u_6, v_u_24):await()
					if v107 and (v108 and v108.IsPaidItemTradingAllowed) then
						return true
					else
						return false, "You are restricted from trading due to Roblox policy!"
					end
				end
			else
				return false, "You are still loading!"
			end
		else
			return false, "You are still loading!"
		end
	else
		return false, "Trading is currently disabled!"
	end
end
function v53.GetTradeValue(_, p109, p110) -- name: GetTradeValue
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_18, (copy) v_u_19
	local v111 = p109.Data
	local v112 = p110.UserId
	local v113 = v111[tostring(v112)]
	if not v113 then
		return 0
	end
	local v114 = 0
	for v115, v116 in v113.Items do
		for _, v117 in v116 do
			v114 = v114 + (v_u_19:GetRAP(v115, (v_u_18:ItemToKey(v115, v117, v_u_19._IGNORE_ATTRIBUTES))) or 0)
		end
	end
	return v114 + v113.Tokens
end

function v_u_60.CheckForSpinLastSpin(p398) -- name: CheckForSpinLastSpin
	local v399 = getCurrentGachaIdentifier(p398.DataReplion)
	local v400 = getCurrentGachaData(p398.DataReplion)
	local v401 = p398.DataReplion:GetExpect({ "GachaData", v399, "TotalSpins" })
	local v402 = v401 - (v401 - v401 % v400.CrateSpinRequirement)
	if v400.CrateSpinRequirement - v402 <= 10 then
		local v403 = p398.DataReplion:GetExpect({ "GachaData", v399, "LastSpunTimeStamp" })
		if v403 then
			if os.time() - v403 >= 90000 then
				p398._urgentLastSpins = true
			else
				p398._urgentLastSpins = false
			end
		end
	else
		p398._urgentLastSpins = false
	end
end

local function v_u_72(p61) -- name: getTopRankedBundle

function v36.UpdateProductRanks(p229) -- name: UpdateProductRanks
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_41, (ref) v_u_37, (ref) v_u_40, (ref) v_u_39, (ref) v_u_38, (copy) v_u_6
	if v_u_41 then

		local v231 = {}
		for _, v232 in v_u_37 or {} do
			for _, v233 in v232.Rewards do
				for _, v234 in v233.Rewards or {} do
					local v235 = v234.ProductId
					if not v235 or v230[v235] then
						continue
					end
					v230[v235] = true
					table.insert(v231, v235)
				end
			end
		end
		table.sort(v231)
		local v236 = table.concat(v231, ",")
		if v236 == v_u_40 then
			return
		else
			v_u_40 = v236
			v_u_39 = v_u_39 + 1
			local v237 = v_u_39
			if #v231 == 0 then
				table.clear(v_u_38)
				return
			else
				local v_u_238 = {}
				for _, v239 in v231 do
					local v240 = {
						["Id"] = v239,
						["InfoType"] = Enum.InfoType.Product
					}
					table.insert(v_u_238, v240)
				end
				local function v241()
					-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_6, (copy) v_u_238
					return v_u_6:RankProductsAsync(v_u_238)
				end
				local v242, v243 = pcall(v241)
				if v242 and typeof(v243) == "table" then
					if v237 == v_u_39 then
						local v244 = {}
						for v245, v246 in v243 do
							v244[v246.ProductIdentifier.Id] = v245
						end
						v_u_38 = v244
						p229:UpdateBundleBar()
						if p229.BundleRewardData and p229.RewardType then
							p229:ShowBuyButtons(p229.BundleRewardData, p229.RewardType)
						end
					end
				else
					if v237 == v_u_39 then
						v_u_40 = nil
					end
					warn((("MarketplaceService:RankProductsAsync() failed for limited sword shop: %*"):format(v243)))
					return
				end
			end
		end
	else
		return
	end
end
function v36.UpdateBundleBar(p247) -- name: UpdateBundleBar
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_34, (copy) v_u_4, (ref) v_u_37, (copy) v_u_17, (copy) v_u_13, (copy) v_u_48, (ref) v_u_35
	debug.profilebegin("LimitedSwordEventPacks:UpdateBundleBar")
	local v248 = v_u_34["Bottom Bar"].ScrollingFrame
	local v249 = p247.CurrentlySelectedBundle
	p247.CurrentlySelectedBundle = nil
	local v250 = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	local v251 = v_u_4.Misc.ShowRooms.SwordPacks.InnerShowRooms
	local v252 = {}
	for v253, v254 in v_u_37 do
		local v255 = v254.FFlagStartTime and v_u_17:GetKey(v254.FFlagStartTime) or (v254.RootFFlagStartTime and (v_u_17:GetKey(v254.RootFFlagStartTime) or 0) or 0)
		local v256 = v254.FFlagEndTime and v_u_17:GetKey(v254.FFlagEndTime) or (v254.RootFFlagEndTime and (v_u_17:GetKey(v254.RootFFlagEndTime) or 0) or 0)
		if v256 <= v250 then

				local v258 = v248:FindFirstChild((("%*_%*"):format(v253, v257.Name)))
				if not v258 then
					continue
				end
				v258:Destroy()
			end
		else
			local v259
			if v255 <= v250 then
				v259 = v250 <= v256
			else
				v259 = false
			end
			for v260, v261 in v254.Rewards do
				if not v251:FindFirstChild(v261.ShowRoom) then
					continue
				end
				local v262 = ("%*_%*"):format(v253, v261.Name)
				local v263 = v248:FindFirstChild(v262)
				if not v263 then
					v263 = p247:CreateBundleOfType(v261, v261.Type or "Sword", v261.TemplateType)
					v263.Name = v262
				end
				v252[v262] = true
				v263.LockedFrame.Visible = not v259
				v263.LockedFrame.TextLabel.Text = string.format("Available In %s", v_u_13:FormatTimeWithDays(v255 - v250))
				v263.LayoutOrder = v_u_48(v261) or (v253 - 1) * 100 + v260
				v263.TextBgQuantity.Visible = false
				v263.Quantity.Visible = false
				v263.TextBg.Visible = v259
				v263.TextBg.TextLabel.Text = v_u_13:FormatTimeWithDays(v256 - v250)
				local v264 = { v261.Stock }
				if v261.Type == "SelectColors" then
					table.clear(v264)
					for _, v265 in v261.Rewards do
						if not v265.Stock then
							continue
						end
						local v266 = v265.Stock
						table.insert(v264, v266)
					end
				end
				if v261.Stock == "Polar Bear" then
					table.insert(v264, "Polar Bear Mount")
				elseif v261.Stock == "Winter Wolf" then
					table.insert(v264, "Winter Wolf Mount")
				end
				if #v264 > 0 then
					local v267 = 0
					local v268 = 0
					for _, v269 in v264 do
						v267 = v267 + (v_u_35:Get({ "Stock", v269 }) or 0)
						v268 = v268 + (v_u_35:Get({ "InitialStock", v269 }) or 0)
					end
					v263.TextBg.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.025, 0.063)
					v263.TextBgQuantity.Visible = true
					v263.Quantity.Visible = true
					if v267 <= 0 then
						v263.Quantity.Text = "SOLD OUT"
						v263.LayoutOrder = v263.LayoutOrder + 1000000000
					else
						v263.Quantity.Text = ("%*/%*"):format(v_u_13:AddCommas((math.ceil(v267))), (v_u_13:AddCommas((math.ceil(v268)))))
					end
				else

				end
				v263.Visible = true
			end
		end
	end
	for _, v270 in v248:GetChildren() do

	local v271

	else

	end

end

end

local function v_u_354() -- name: buildBundleEntries
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_26, (copy) v_u_64, (copy) v_u_70, (copy) v_u_335, (copy) v_u_49
	local v336 = v_u_4.Misc.ShowRooms.SwordPacks.InnerShowRooms
	local v337 = 0
	local v338 = {}
	local v339 = {}
	local v340 = {}
	for v341, v342 in v_u_26:GetActiveBundles() do
		local v343 = v342.RootFFlagStartTime or ("pack%*"):format(v341)
		if not v338[v343] then
			v337 = v337 + 1
			v338[v343] = v337
			v340[v343] = 0
		end
		for _, v344 in v342.Rewards do
			if not v336:FindFirstChild(v344.ShowRoom) then
				continue
			end

			local v346, v347 = v_u_70(v345)
			local v348

				v348 = v347 > 0
			else

			end
			if v348 and v346 <= 0 then
				continue
			end

			local v349 = {
				["Bundle"] = v344,
				["Pack"] = v342,
				["Key"] = v341 .. "_" .. v344.Name,

	end)

function v_u_58.RegisterTuningCommands(p_u_502) -- name: RegisterTuningCommands
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_32, (copy) v_u_25
	for v_u_503 in v_u_32 do
		v_u_25.register_quick(("showcase_%*"):format((string.lower(v_u_503))), function(p504)
			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_503, (ref) v_u_32, (copy) p_u_502
			if p504 == nil then
				local v505 = v_u_503
				return ("%* = %*"):format(v505, v_u_32[v505])
			end
			if typeof(p504) ~= "number" then
				return ("%* precisa de um numero"):format(v_u_503)
			end
			v_u_32[v_u_503] = v_u_32[v_u_503] + p504
			p_u_502:ApplyTuning()
			local v506 = v_u_503
			return ("%* = %*"):format(v506, v_u_32[v506])
		end)
	end
	v_u_25.register_quick("showcase_set", function(p507, p508)
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_32, (copy) p_u_502
		if typeof(p507) ~= "string" then
			return "uso: showcase_set <campo> <valor>"
		end
		local v509 = nil
		for v510 in v_u_32 do
			if string.lower(v510) ~= string.lower(p507) then
				continue
			end
			v509 = v510
		end
		if not v509 then
			return ("campo desconhecido: %*"):format(p507)
		end
		if typeof(p508) ~= "number" then
			return ("%* = %*"):format(v509, v_u_32[v509])
		end
		v_u_32[v509] = p508
		p_u_502:ApplyTuning()
		return ("%* = %*"):format(v509, v_u_32[v509])
	end)
	v_u_25.register_quick("showcase_dump", function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_502
		return p_u_502:DumpTuning()
	end)
	v_u_25.register_quick("showcase_previews", function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_502
		return p_u_502:DumpPreviews()
	end)
	v_u_25.register_quick("showcase_reload", function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_502
		p_u_502:ApplyTuning()
		return p_u_502:DumpTuning()
	end)
end

function v117._loadHistoryPlacements(p196, p197) -- name: _loadHistoryPlacements
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_9, (copy) v_u_137, (copy) v_u_35, (copy) v_u_17, (copy) v_u_71, (copy) v_u_47
	p196:_clearHistoryPlacements()
	local v198 = v_u_9.UserId
	local v199 = tostring(v198)
	local v200 = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	local v201 = {}
	local v202 = 0
	for v203, v204 in p197 do
		for _, v205 in v204 do
			table.insert(v201, {
				["match"] = v205,
				["mode"] = v203
			})
		end
	end
	table.sort(v201, function(p206, p207)
		return p206.match.StartTime > p207.match.StartTime
	end)
	local v208 = #v201
	for v209 = 1, math.min(v208, 20) do
		local v210 = v201[v209]
		local v211 = v210.match
		local v212 = v211.Kills or "-"
		local v213 = v211.Deaths or "-"
		local v214 = v211.Points or "-"
		local v215 = v211.Abandoned or false
		local v216 = v211.RatingChange or 0
		local v217 = v211.RatingAdjusted or false
		local v218 = (v211.Placements or {})[v199] or "-"
		local v219 = v200 - (v211.EndTime or (v211.StartTime or 1))
		local v220 = not (v211.EndTime or v211.StartTime) and "-" or v_u_137(v219) .. " Ago"
		local v221 = nil
		local v222 = 0
		for _, v223 in v211.Teams do
			v221 = v221 or v223[v199]
			v222 = v222 + 1
		end
		local v224 = not v221 and "-" or tonumber(v221) + v216
		if v219 >= v202 then
			v202 = v219
		end
		local v225 = v216 > 0
		local v226 = v210.mode == "Duo" and "2v2 Duos" or (v210.mode == "Duel" and "1v1s" or "Free for All")
		local v227 = v_u_35:Clone()
		v227.LayoutOrder = v219
		v227.Content.Kills.Text = tostring(v212)
		v227.Content.Points.Text = tostring(v214)
		v227.Content.Deaths.Text = tostring(v213)
		v227.Content.GameType.Text = v226
		v227.Content.TimeSince.Text = v220
		v227.Content.ELOChange.RankIcon.Image = not tonumber(v224) and "" or v_u_17.GetRank(v224).Icon
		local v228 = v216 == 0 and "#ffffff" or (v225 and "#0cf01f" or "#ff4943")
		local v229
		if v217 then
			v229 = ("<stroke color=\"#1A2B6D\" joins=\"miter\" thickness=\"2\"><b>%*</b> <font color=\"%*\">(%*%*)</font></stroke>"):format(v224, v228, v225 and "+" or "", v216)
		else
			v229 = ("<stroke color=\"#1A2B6D\" joins=\"miter\" thickness=\"2\"><b>%*</b><font color=\"#ffffff\"> (+0)</font></stroke>"):format(v224)
		end
		local v230 = v211.Canceled and "<stroke color=\"#1A2B6D\" joins=\"miter\" thickness=\"2\"><b><font color=\"#f57e2a\">Canceled</font></b></stroke>" or (v215 and "<stroke color=\"#1A2B6D\" joins=\"miter\" thickness=\"2\"><b><font color=\"#ff4943\">Abandoned</font></b></stroke>" or (v211.InProgress and v219 < 86400 and "<stroke color=\"#1A2B6D\" joins=\"miter\" thickness=\"2\"><b><font color=\"#0cf01f\">In Progress</font></b></stroke>" or (not tonumber(v218) and "<stroke color=\"#1A2B6D\" joins=\"miter\" thickness=\"2\"><b><font color=\"#f57e2a\">No Result</font></b></stroke>" or ("<stroke color=\"#1A2B6D\" joins=\"miter\" thickness=\"2\"><b><font color=\"#f7d708\">%*</font></b>/%*</stroke>"):format(not tonumber(v218) and "-" or "#" .. v218, v222))))
		v227.Content.ELOChange.Text = v229
		v227.Content.PlaceNumber.Text = v230
		v227.Parent = v_u_71
	end
	local v231 = v_u_35:Clone()
	v231:ClearAllChildren()
	v231.LayoutOrder = v202 + 1
	v231.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	v231.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.125)
	v231.Parent = v_u_71
	v_u_47.NoMatchesPlayed.Visible = #v201 == 0
end

function v117._loadLeaderboard(p_u_233) -- name: _loadLeaderboard
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_93, (ref) v_u_114, (copy) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_97, (copy) v_u_22
	p_u_233._playerList = {
		["Normal"] = {
			["FFA"] = {},
			["2v2 Duos"] = {},
			["1v1s"] = {}
		},
		["NoAbility"] = {
			["FFA"] = {},
			["2v2 Duos"] = {},
			["1v1s"] = {}
		}
	}
	p_u_233._drawingFrames = false
	p_u_233._leaderboardMode = "FFA"
	p_u_233._leaderboardFilter = "GLOBAL"
	p_u_233._awaitingLeaderboardLoad = 0
	p_u_233._leaderboardRenderDirty = false
	p_u_233._pendingLeaderboardMode = "FFA"
	p_u_233:_hookLazyLeaderboardRender()
	if v_u_93 then
		v_u_114 = {
			["FFA"] = v_u_11.FetchTop100Leaderboard:InvokeServer("EloFFA") or {},
			["1v1s"] = v_u_11.FetchTop100Leaderboard:InvokeServer("EloDuel") or {},
			["2v2 Duos"] = v_u_11.FetchTop100Leaderboard:InvokeServer("EloDuo") or {}
		}
	else
		v_u_97:Connect(function(p234)
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_114, (ref) v_u_11, (copy) p_u_233
			if not v_u_114[p234] then
				v_u_114[p234] = {
					["FFA"] = v_u_11.FetchTop100Leaderboard:InvokeServer("EloFFA") or {},
					["1v1s"] = v_u_11.FetchTop100Leaderboard:InvokeServer("EloDuel") or {},
					["2v2 Duos"] = v_u_11.FetchTop100Leaderboard:InvokeServer("EloDuo") or {}
				}
				p_u_233:_registerLeaderboards()
			end
		end)
	end
	task.delay(5, function()
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_22, (ref) v_u_93, (ref) v_u_114, (ref) v_u_11, (copy) p_u_233
		while true do
			if v_u_22:GetKey("LeaderboardRankedEnabled") then
				if v_u_93 then
					v_u_114 = {
						["FFA"] = v_u_11.FetchTop100Leaderboard:InvokeServer("EloFFA") or {},
						["1v1s"] = v_u_11.FetchTop100Leaderboard:InvokeServer("EloDuel") or {},
						["2v2 Duos"] = v_u_11.FetchTop100Leaderboard:InvokeServer("EloDuo") or {}
					}
				else
					for v235, v236 in v_u_114 do
						for v237, _ in v236 do
							v_u_114[v235][v237] = v_u_11.FetchTop100Leaderboard:InvokeServer(v237, v235) or {}
						end
					end
				end
				p_u_233:_registerLeaderboards()
			end
			task.wait(300)
		end
	end)
	p_u_233:_initiateLeaderboardTimer()
end
function v117._renderLeaderboard(p238, p239, p240) -- name: _renderLeaderboard
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_105, (copy) v_u_113, (copy) v_u_31, (ref) v_u_94, (copy) v_u_19, (copy) v_u_32, (copy) v_u_49
	if p238._drawingFrames then
		return
	end
	p238._drawingFrames = true
	local v241 = os.clock()
	local v242 = v_u_105[p238._leaderboardFilter .. p239] or v_u_105.Main
	p238:_toggleLeaderboardFrame(v242)
	if not p240 and v241 < v_u_113[v242] then
		p238._drawingFrames = false
		return
	end
	v_u_31.Parent = script
	p238:_clearLeaderboard("Main")

function v117._loadAbilityStats(_, p326) -- name: _loadAbilityStats
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_69
	if typeof(p326) == "table" then
		local v_u_327 = 0
		for _, v328 in p326 do
			v_u_327 = v_u_327 + v328
		end
		local function v333(p329, p330) -- name: updateAbility
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_327
			local v331 = p329:FindFirstChild("TimeCounter")
			local v332 = p329:FindFirstChild("BarFrame")
			if v331 then
				p329.TimeCounter.Text = tostring(p330) .. " Rounds"
			end
			p329.LayoutOrder = 9000000 - p330
			if v332 then
				v332.Progress.Size = UDim2.fromScale(p330 / v_u_327, 1)
			end
		end
		for v334, v335 in next, p326 do
			local v336 = v_u_69:FindFirstChild(v334)
			if not v336 then
				continue
			end
			v333(v336, v335)
		end
		for _, v337 in v_u_69:GetChildren() do
			if not v337:IsA("GuiObject") or p326[v337.Name] then
				continue
			end
			local v338 = v337:FindFirstChild("TimeCounter")
			local v339 = v337:FindFirstChild("BarFrame")
			if v338 then
				v337.TimeCounter.Text = tostring(0) .. " Rounds"
			end
			v337.LayoutOrder = 9000000
			if not v339 then
				continue
			end
			v339.Progress.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0 / v_u_327, 1)
		end
	end
end

function v117._toggleWindow(p356, p357, p358) -- name: _toggleWindow

			continue

	v_u_37.Title.Visible = p357 ~= v_u_48

		v361 = p357 ~= v_u_45
	end

	v_u_38.Visible = v_u_38 == p357

	for _, v362 in v_u_37.Tabs:GetChildren() do

			continue
		end

		if v362.Name == v_u_109[p357] then

		else

		end

	end
	p356._openedFromPartyButton = p358 or false
end

function v_u_107._updateInventoryLimit(_, p529) -- name: _updateInventoryLimit
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_31, (copy) v_u_77, (copy) v_u_30
	local v530 = v_u_31[p529]
	local v531 = v_u_77.InventoryLimit
	if v530 then
		local v532 = v_u_30:Get(p529) or {}
		local v533 = 0
		for _, _ in pairs(v532) do
			v533 = v533 + 1
		end
		local v534 = v530 * 0.8
		if v533 < v534 then
			v531.Visible = false
		else
			v531.Text = ("%*/%*"):format(v533, v530)
			v531.TextColor3 = Color3.fromHSV(0.15 * (1 - v534 / v530), 1, 1)
			v531.Visible = true
		end
	else
		v531.Visible = false
		return
	end
end
function v_u_107._updateMultiDelete(p_u_535) -- name: _updateMultiDelete
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_77, (copy) v_u_30, (copy) v_u_42, (copy) v_u_38, (copy) v_u_39, (copy) v_u_14
	local v536 = v_u_77.DeleteItems.List.ContentsCanvas.ScrollingFrame
	if p_u_535._multiDelete then
		for _, v537 in v536:GetChildren() do
			if not v537:IsA("GuiObject") then
				continue
			end
			local v538 = v537:GetAttribute("InventoryType")
			local v539 = v537.Name
			if p_u_535._multiDelete[v538] and #(p_u_535._multiDelete[v538][v539] or {}) > 0 then
				continue
			end
			v537:Destroy()
		end
		for v_u_540, v541 in p_u_535._multiDelete do
			for v_u_542, v_u_543 in v541 do
				local v_u_544 = v_u_30:KeyToItem(v_u_542)

					local v_u_546 = v536.UIListLayout.Template:Clone()
					v_u_546.Name = v_u_542
					v_u_546.Parent = v536
					v_u_42:Add(v_u_546, v_u_540, v_u_544, v_u_542)

						-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_543, (copy) p_u_535, (copy) v_u_540, (copy) v_u_542, (ref) v_u_546, (copy) v_u_544
						table.remove(v_u_543, 1)
						if #v_u_543 <= 0 then
							p_u_535._multiDelete[v_u_540][v_u_542] = nil
							v_u_546:Destroy()

	end
end

function v_u_107._addToMultiDelete(p554, p555, p556) -- name: _addToMultiDelete
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_35, (copy) v_u_30
	local v557, v558 = p554:_canDelete(p555, p556)
	if v557 then
		local v559 = p554._multiDelete
		if v559 then
			v559 = p554._multiDelete[p555]
		end
		if v559 then
			if not v559[p556] then
				v559[p556] = {}
			end
			local v560 = v_u_30:FindItemsWithKey(p555, p556)
			for _, v561 in v559[p556] do
				local v562 = table.find(v560, v561)
				if not v562 then
					continue
				end
				table.remove(v560, v562)
			end
			if #v560 > 0 and not table.find(v559[p556], v560[1]) then
				local v563 = v559[p556]
				local v564 = v560[1]
				table.insert(v563, v564)
				p554:_updateItemStatus(p555, v_u_30:KeyToItem(p556).Name, p556)
				p554:_updateMultiDelete()
			end
		else
			return
		end
	else
		if v558 then
			v_u_35:SendNotification(v558)
		end
		return
	end
end

function v_u_107.GoTo(p570, p571, p572) -- name: GoTo
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_18, (copy) v_u_84, (copy) v_u_80, (copy) v_u_79, (copy) v_u_78, (copy) v_u_76, (copy) v_u_77

	v_u_84.Visible = false
	v_u_84:SetAttribute("Visible", false)
	if not p570._page or (p570._page.Name ~= v573 or p572) then

		if p570._page then
			p570._page.Visible = false
			local v574 = v_u_80

			assert(v574:FindFirstChild(v575)).Image = "rbxassetid://14782684812"
		end
		for _, v576 in v_u_79:GetChildren() do
			if not v576:IsA("GuiObject") then
				continue
			end
			v576.Visible = false
		end

		local v578 = ("Could not find \"%*!\""):format(v573)
		local v579 = assert(v577, v578)
		v579.Visible = true
		local v580 = v_u_80
		assert(v580:FindFirstChild(v573)).Image = "rbxassetid://14782680596"
		p570._page = v579

			p570._loadInventoryPage(v573)
		end
		p570:_updateInventoryLimit(v573)
		v_u_77.Delete.Visible = v573 == "Explosion" and true or v573 == "Sword"
		p570:_updateMultiDeleteVisbility()
	end
end

					v_u_632.EndBatch()

					end

		end

function v_u_71.UpdateDeletingItems(p_u_82) -- name: UpdateDeletingItems

end

function v_u_71.EquipCurrent(_) -- name: EquipCurrent
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_48, (copy) v_u_71, (copy) v_u_17, (copy) v_u_28, (copy) v_u_18, (copy) v_u_24
	local v92 = v_u_48:Get()
	for _, v93 in v_u_71.PageInfo do
		if v93.PageName ~= v92 then
			continue
		end
		local v94 = v93.ItemState:Get()
		if not v94 then
			continue
		end
		local v95 = v94.ItemInfo
		local v96 = v95.ItemType
		if v95.ItemType == "Ability" then
			if v94.OwnedCopies:Get() > 0 then
				local v97 = v95.Name
				v_u_28:SetEquipped(v96, v_u_17:FindItemsWithKey(v96, v94.ParsedItemKey)[1] or v97)
			elseif v95.Pack then
				v_u_18:Open(v95.Pack.Menu)
			else
				v_u_28:RequestAbilityPurchase(v94.ItemInfo.Name)
			end
		elseif v94.ItemInfo.IsInventorey then
			local v98 = v95.Name
			v_u_28:SetEquipped(v96, v_u_17:FindItemsWithKey(v96, v94.ParsedItemKey)[1] or v98)
		elseif v95.ItemType == "DevProduct" then
			v_u_24:PromptPurchase(v95.ProductId, Enum.InfoType.Product)
		else
			if v95.ItemType ~= "GamePass" then
				continue
			end
			if v94.Owns:Get() then
				return
			end
			v_u_24:PromptPurchase(v95.ProductId, Enum.InfoType.GamePass)
		end
	end
end
function v_u_71.UpgradeCurrent(_) -- name: UpgradeCurrent
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_48, (copy) v_u_71, (copy) v_u_18, (copy) v_u_28, (copy) v_u_17, (copy) v_u_42, (copy) v_u_32
	local v99 = v_u_48:Get()
	for _, v100 in v_u_71.PageInfo do
		if v100.PageName ~= v99 then
			continue
		end
		local v101 = v100.ItemState:Get()
		if not v101 then
			continue
		end
		local v102 = v101.ItemInfo
		if v102.ItemType == "Ability" then
			if v101.OwnedCopies:Get() <= 0 then
				return
			end
			if v102.Upgrade.CustomUpgrade then
				v_u_18:Open(v102.Upgrade.CustomUpgrade)
			else
				if not v_u_28:RequestAbilityUpgrade(v_u_17:FindItemsWithKey(v102.ItemType, v101.ParsedItemKey)[1]) then
					continue
				end
				local v103 = v_u_17:KeyToItem(v101.ParsedItemKey)
				v103.Upgrade = (v103.Upgrade or 0) + 1
				v_u_42.Ability:Set(v_u_28:GetAbilityData(v_u_28:ParseItemKey("Ability", v103)))
			end
		elseif v102.ItemType == "DevProduct" then
			v_u_32:SetGift(v102.DisplayName)
		else
			if v102.ItemType ~= "GamePass" then
				continue
			end
			v_u_32:SetGift(v102.GiftName)
		end
	end
end

				v_u_47.Visible = false

			end

function v_u_32.RenderSword(_, p_u_102, p_u_103, p104) -- name: RenderSword
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_12, (copy) v_u_30, (copy) v_u_21, (copy) v_u_16, (copy) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_31, (copy) v_u_26
	local v_u_105 = p_u_102.ItemInfo
	p_u_103:WaitForChild("EquipButton")
	local v_u_106 = p_u_103:WaitForChild("Favorite")
	p104:Add(v_u_12.Computed(function(p107)
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_30, (copy) p_u_102, (copy) p_u_103
		local v108 = v_u_30[p_u_102.ItemInfo.Rarity]
		local v109 = p107(p_u_102.Owns)
		if v109 then
			local v110 = v108 - 4
			v108 = math.abs(v110)
		end
		p_u_103.LayoutOrder = v108 or -1
		local v111 = p_u_103
		v111.LayoutOrder = v111.LayoutOrder + (p107(p_u_102.IsFavorited) and -500 or 0)
		local v112 = p_u_103
		v112.LayoutOrder = v112.LayoutOrder + (v109 and -100 or 0)
	end))
	p104:Add(v_u_12.Computed(function(p113)
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_106, (copy) p_u_102
		v_u_106.Visible = p113(p_u_102.Owns)
		v_u_106.Image = p113(p_u_102.IsFavorited) and "rbxassetid://15697987058" or "rbxassetid://15697983062"
	end))
	v_u_21.animateButtonClick(v_u_106)
	v_u_106.Activated:Connect(function()
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_16, (copy) v_u_105
		v_u_16:ToggleFavorited(v_u_105)
	end)
	p104:Add(v_u_12.setPropertyComputed(p_u_103, "Visible", function(p114)
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_105, (copy) p_u_102
		return not v_u_105.Hidden or (p114(p_u_102.Owns) or v_u_105.AlwaysVisible)
	end))

		p_u_103.ViewportFrame.Visible = false

		p_u_103.ItemIcon.Visible = false

	p_u_103.Parent = v_u_26.Swords.Items
end

function v_u_1.addBusinessEvent(_, p_u_47, p_u_48) -- name: addBusinessEvent
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_35, (copy) v_u_29, (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_25, (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_9, (copy) v_u_6
	v_u_3:performTaskOnGAThread(function()
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_4, (ref) v_u_35, (copy) p_u_47, (ref) v_u_29, (ref) v_u_1, (copy) p_u_48, (ref) v_u_25, (ref) v_u_7, (ref) v_u_9, (ref) v_u_6
		if v_u_4:isEventSubmissionEnabled() then
			if v_u_35({
				["playerId"] = nil,
				["needsInitialized"] = true,
				["shouldWarn"] = false,
				["message"] = "Could not add business event",

			}) then
				local v49 = p_u_48.amount or 0

				local v51 = p_u_48.itemId or ""
				local v52 = p_u_48.cartType or ""

				local v55 = p_u_48.gamepassId or nil

					local v57 = v_u_6:GetPlayerDataFromCache(p_u_47)
					if not v57.OwnedGamepasses then

				return
			elseif p_u_47 then

	end)

function v_u_1.PlayerJoined(_, p_u_90) -- name: PlayerJoined
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_6, (copy) v_u_15, (copy) v_u_8, (copy) v_u_13, (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_16, (copy) v_u_12, (copy) v_u_10, (copy) v_u_17, (copy) v_u_22
	local v91 = p_u_90:GetJoinData().TeleportData
	local v92 = v_u_6:GetPlayerData(p_u_90)
	local v93
	if v91 then
		v93 = v91.gameanalyticsData
		if v93 then
			local v94 = v91.gameanalyticsData
			local v95 = p_u_90.UserId
			v93 = v94[tostring(v95)]
		end
	else
		v93 = nil
	end
	local v96 = v_u_6:GetPlayerDataFromCache(p_u_90.UserId)
	if v96 then
		if v93 then
			v96.SessionID = v93.SessionID
			v96.SessionStart = v93.SessionStart
		end
		v96.PlayerTeleporting = false
	else
		local v97, v98 = v_u_15.invokeClient("getPlatform", p_u_90, 5)
		local v99 = not v97 and "unknown" or v98
		for v100, v101 in pairs(v_u_6.BasePlayerData) do
			if v92[v100] then
				continue
			end
			if typeof(v101) == "table" then
				v92[v100] = v_u_8:copyTable(v101)
			else
				v92[v100] = v101
			end
		end
		local function v102()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_13, (copy) p_u_90
			return v_u_13:GetCountryRegionForPlayerAsync(p_u_90)
		end
		local v103, v104 = pcall(v102)
		if v103 then
			v92.CountryCode = v104
		end
		v_u_6.PlayerCache[p_u_90.UserId] = v92
		local v105
		if v99 == "Console" then
			v105 = "uwp_console"
		elseif v99 == "Mobile" then
			v105 = "uwp_mobile"
		else
			local _ = v99 == "Desktop"
			v105 = "uwp_desktop"
		end
		v92.Platform = v105
		v92.OS = v92.Platform .. " 0.0.0"
		if not v103 then
			v_u_7:addSdkErrorEvent(p_u_90.UserId, "event_validation", "player_joined", "string_empty_or_null", "country_code", "")
		end
		local v106 = ""
		local v107
		if v_u_4.UseCustomUserId then
			local v108
			v108, v107 = v_u_15.invokeClient("getCustomUserId", p_u_90, 5)
			if not v108 then
				v107 = v106
			end
		else
			v107 = v106
		end
		if not v_u_8:isStringNullOrEmpty(v107) then
			v_u_2:i("Using custom id: " .. v107)
			v92.CustomUserId = v107
		end
		v_u_1:startNewSession(p_u_90, v93)
		v_u_16 = v_u_16 or v_u_12:WaitForChild("OnPlayerReadyEvent")
		v_u_16:Fire(p_u_90)
		if v_u_4.AutomaticSendBusinessEvents then
			if v92.OwnedGamepasses == nil then
				v92.OwnedGamepasses = {}
				for _, v109 in ipairs(v_u_4._availableGamepasses) do
					if not v_u_10:UserOwnsGamePassAsync(p_u_90.UserId, v109) then
						continue
					end
					local v110 = v92.OwnedGamepasses
					table.insert(v110, v109)
				end
				v_u_6.PlayerCache[p_u_90.UserId] = v92
				v_u_6:SavePlayerData(p_u_90)
			else
				local v111 = {}
				for _, v112 in ipairs(v_u_4._availableGamepasses) do
					if not v_u_10:UserOwnsGamePassAsync(p_u_90.UserId, v112) then
						continue
					end
					table.insert(v111, v112)
				end
				local v113 = {}
				for _, v114 in ipairs(v92.OwnedGamepasses) do
					v113[v114] = true
				end
				for _, v115 in ipairs(v111) do

	local function v_u_23(p10, p11, p12, p13) -- name: updateValueByIndex
		if typeof(p10) == "number" then
			return p12
		end
		if typeof(p10) == "Vector2" then
			if p11 == 1 then
				return Vector2.new(p12, p10.Y)
			end

				return Vector2.new(p10.X, p12)
			end

			if p11 == 1 then

			end
			if p11 == 2 then

			end
			if p11 == 3 then

				local v19 = p10.Y

			end
		elseif typeof(p10) == "UDim" then
			if p11 == 1 then
				return UDim.new(p12, p10.Offset)
			end
			if p11 == 2 then
				return UDim.new(p10.Scale, p12)
			end
		elseif typeof(p10) == "UDim2" then
			if p11 == 1 then
				return UDim2.new(UDim.new(p12, p10.X.Offset), p10.Y)
			end
			if p11 == 2 then

			end
			if p11 == 3 then
				return UDim2.new(p10.X, UDim.new(p12, p10.Y.Offset))
			end
			if p11 == 4 then
				return UDim2.new(p10.X, UDim.new(p10.Y.Scale, p12))
			end
		elseif typeof(p10) == "Rect" then
			if p11 == 1 then
				return Rect.new(Vector2.new(p12, p10.Min.Y), p10.Max)
			end
			if p11 == 2 then
				return Rect.new(Vector2.new(p10.Min.X, p12), p10.Max)
			end
			if p11 == 3 then
				return Rect.new(p10.Min, Vector2.new(p12, p10.Max.Y))
			end
			if p11 == 4 then
				return Rect.new(p10.Min, Vector2.new(p10.Max.X, p12))
			end
		elseif typeof(p10) == "Color3" then
			if p13.UseHSV then
				local v20, v21, v22 = p10:ToHSV()
				if p11 == 1 then
					return Color3.fromHSV(p12, v21, v22)
				end
				if p11 == 2 then
					return Color3.fromHSV(v20, p12, v22)

				if p11 == 3 then
					return Color3.fromHSV(v20, v21, p12)
				end
			end
			if p11 == 1 then
				return Color3.new(p12, p10.G, p10.B)
			end
			if p11 == 2 then
				return Color3.new(p10.R, p12, p10.B)
			end
			if p11 == 3 then
				return Color3.new(p10.R, p10.G, p12)
			end
		end

	end

		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_26, (ref) v_u_27, (copy) v_u_28, (copy) p_u_1, (ref) v_u_15, (copy) p_u_2
		if v_u_26 ~= p68 then
			if v_u_27 and v_u_26 ~= nil then
				if v_u_28[v_u_26.ID] then
					local v69 = v_u_26.Instance.WindowButton
					local v70 = v69.TitleBar
					if v_u_26.state.isUncollapsed.value then
						v70.BackgroundColor3 = p_u_1._config.TitleBgColor
						v70.BackgroundTransparency = p_u_1._config.TitleBgTransparency
					else
						v70.BackgroundColor3 = p_u_1._config.TitleBgCollapsedColor
						v70.BackgroundTransparency = p_u_1._config.TitleBgCollapsedTransparency
					end
					v69.UIStroke.Color = p_u_1._config.BorderColor
				end
				v_u_27 = false
				v_u_26 = nil
			end
			if p68 ~= nil then
				v_u_27 = true
				v_u_26 = p68
				local v71 = p68.Instance
				local v72 = v71.WindowButton
				local v73 = v72.TitleBar
				v73.BackgroundColor3 = p_u_1._config.TitleBgActiveColor
				v73.BackgroundTransparency = p_u_1._config.TitleBgActiveTransparency
				v72.UIStroke.Color = p_u_1._config.BorderActiveColor
				v_u_15 = v_u_15 + 1
				if p68.usesScreenGUI then
					v71.DisplayOrder = v_u_15 + p_u_1._config.DisplayOrderOffset
				end
				if p68.state.isUncollapsed.value == false then
					p68.state.isUncollapsed:set(true)
				end
				if p_u_2.GuiService.SelectedObject then
					if v73.Visible then
						p_u_2.GuiService:Select(v73)
						return
					end
					p_u_2.GuiService:Select(v71.ChildContainer)
				end
			end
		end
	end

			if not v115 then
				error(("\"%*\" is not a valid suffix"):format(v115), 0)
			end

			if not v116 then
				error(("could not convert \"%*\" into a duration"):format(v112), 0)
			end
			v111 = v111 + v116 * v115
		else
			local v117 = tonumber(v112)
			if not v117 then
				error(("could not convert \"%*\" into a duration"):format(v112), 0)
			end
			v111 = v111 + v117
		end
	end
	return v111
end

local function v_u_84(p68, p69, p70) -- name: match_eval_value
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_84
	if p69.kind == "literal" then
		if p68 == p69.value then
			return p69
		else
			return nil
		end
	elseif p69.kind == "command" or p69.kind == "function" then
		if typeof(p68) == "function" then
			return p69
		else
			return nil
		end
	elseif p69.kind == "strange" then
		local v71
		if p70 then
			v71 = p69.exact_match or p69.match
		else
			v71 = p69.match
		end
		if v71 then
			if typeof(v71) == "table" then
				if v_u_84(p68, v71, p70) then
					return p69
				else
					return nil
				end
			elseif v71(p68) then
				return p69
			else
				return nil
			end
		else
			return p69
		end
	else
		if p69.kind == "intersection" then
			for _, v72 in p69.fields do
				if v_u_84(p68, v72, p70) then
					continue
				end
				return nil
			end
			return p69
		end
		if p69.kind == "union" then
			local v73 = {}
			for _, v74 in p69.fields do
				if not v_u_84(p68, v74, p70) then
					continue
				end
				table.insert(v73, p69)
			end
			return #v73 > 0 and {
				["kind"] = "union",
				["fields"] = nil,
				["fields"] = v73
			} or nil
		end
		if p69.kind ~= "table" then
			return p69
		end
		local v75 = {}
		if p69.fields then
			for v76, v77 in p69.fields do
				local v78 = rawget
				local v79 = v76.value
				local v80, v81 = pcall(v78, p68, v79)
				if not v80 then
					return nil
				end
				if not v_u_84(v81, v77, p70) then
					return nil
				end
				if not v76.value then
					continue
				end
				v75[v76.value] = p68
			end
		end
		if typeof(p68) == "table" and (p69.indexer or p69.value) then
			for v82, v83 in pairs(p68) do
				if v75[v82] then
					continue
				end
				if p69.indexer and not v_u_84(v82, p69.indexer, p70) then
					return nil
				end
				if not p69.value or v_u_84(v83, p69.value, p70) then
					continue
				end
				return nil
			end
		end
		return p69
	end
end
local function v_u_101(p85, p86, p87, p88) -- name: match
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_37, (copy) v_u_84, (copy) v_u_101
	if p86 then
		if p86.kind == "var" then
			local v89 = nil
			if p86.root.kind == "global" then
				v89 = p85.globals[p86.root.token.text]
			elseif p86.root.kind == "name" and p86.root.name then
				v89 = p85.vars[p86.root.name.text]
			elseif p86.root.kind == "paren" and p86.root.node.value then
				v89 = v_u_37(p86.root.node.value)
			end
			if not v89 then
				return nil
			end
			for _, v90 in p86.suffixes do
				if v90.kind == "expression_index" then
					local v91 = v_u_37(v90.node.value)
					local v92 = rawget
					local v93
					v93, v89 = pcall(v92, v89, v91)
					if v93 then
						continue
					end
					return nil
				end
				if v90.kind ~= "name_index" or not v90.name then
					continue
				end
				local v94 = v90.name.text
				local v95 = rawget
				local v96
				v96, v89 = pcall(v95, v89, v94)
				if v96 then
					continue
				end
				return nil
			end
			return v_u_84(v89, p87, p88)
		elseif p87.kind == "command" then
			if p86.kind == "command" then
				return p87
			else
				return nil
			end
		elseif p87.kind == "function" then
			if p86.kind == "lambda" then
				return p87
			else
				return nil
			end
		elseif p87.kind == "intersection" then
			for _, v97 in p87.fields do
				if v_u_101(p85, p86, v97, p88) then
					continue
				end
				return nil
			end
			return p87
		elseif p87.kind == "union" then
			local v98 = {}
			for _, v99 in p87.fields do
				if not v_u_101(p85, p86, v99, p88) then
					continue
				end
				table.insert(v98, v99)
			end
			return #v98 > 0 and {
				["kind"] = "union",
				["fields"] = nil,
				["fields"] = v98
			} or nil
		else
			if p87.kind == "strange" then
				local v100 = p87.match
				if typeof(v100) == "table" then
					if v_u_101(p85, p86, p87.match, p88) then
						return p87
					else
						return nil
					end
				end
			end
			if p87.kind == "strange" or (p87.kind == "literal" or p87.kind == "table") then
				return v_u_84(v_u_37(p86), p87, p88)
			else
				return nil
			end
		end
	else
		return nil
	end
end

function v_u_38.visit_command(p214, p215) -- name: visit_command

	["is_compatible"] = function(p1, p2) -- name: is_compatible
		if p1.major == 0 and p2.minor == 0 then

			else
				return "likely_incompatible", ("requires %*, likely incompatible with %*"):format(("%*.%*.%*"):format(p1.major, p1.minor, p1.patch), (("%*.%*.%*"):format(p2.major, p2.minor, p2.patch)))
			end
		elseif p1.major == 0 then
			if p1.minor > p2.minor then
				return "likely_incompatible", ("requires %*, likely incompatible with %*"):format(("%*.%*.%*"):format(p1.major, p1.minor, p1.patch), (("%*.%*.%*"):format(p2.major, p2.minor, p2.patch)))
			end
			if p1.minor == p2.minor then
				if p1.patch <= p2.patch then
					return "ok", nil
				end
				if p1.patch > p2.patch then
					return "compatible", ("requires %*, while likely compatible with %*, API might not function as expected"):format(("%*.%*.%*"):format(p1.major, p1.minor, p1.patch), (("%*.%*.%*"):format(p2.major, p2.minor, p2.patch)))

			end
			return "bad", ("unreachable condition reached %* %*"):format(("%*.%*.%*"):format(p1.major, p1.minor, p1.patch), (("%*.%*.%*"):format(p2.major, p2.minor, p2.patch)))

			if p1.minor > p2.minor then

	describe("Promise:cancel", function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_6
		it("should mark promises as cancelled and not resolve or reject them", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v_u_132 = 0
			local v_u_133 = 0

		it("should call the cancellation hook once", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1

		it("should propagate cancellations", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1

			local v139 = v138:andThen()
			local v140 = v138:andThen()
			expect(v138:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)
			expect(v139:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)
			expect(v140:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)
			v139:cancel()
			expect(v138:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)
			expect(v139:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Cancelled)
			expect(v140:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)
			v140:cancel()
			expect(v138:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Cancelled)
			expect(v139:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Cancelled)

		end)

		it("should track consumers", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1

			local v144 = v_u_1.resolve()
			local v_u_145 = v144:andThen(function()

				-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_145
				p146(v_u_145)

			expect(v_u_145._parent).to.never.equal(v144)
			expect(v147._parent).to.never.equal(v_u_145)

		it("should cancel resolved pending promises", function()

	describe("Promise:finally", function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
		it("should be called upon resolve, reject, or cancel", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v_u_153 = 0
			local function v154() -- name: finally
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_153
				v_u_153 = v_u_153 + 1
			end
			v_u_1.new(function(p155, _)
				p155()

		it("should cancel returned promise if cancelled", function()

	describe("Promise.all", function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_7
		it("should error if given something other than a table", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			expect(function()
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
				v_u_1.all(1)
			end).to.throw()
		end)
		it("should resolve instantly with an empty table if given no promises", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v181 = v_u_1.all({})
			local v182, v183 = v181:_unwrap()
			expect(v182).to.equal(true)
			expect(v181:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Resolved)
			expect(v183).to.be.a("table")

		end)
		it("should error if given non-promise values", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1

				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
				v_u_1.all({
					{},
					{},
					{}
				})
			end).to.throw()
		end)
		it("should wait for all promises to be resolved and return their values", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_7, (ref) v_u_1
			local v184, v_u_185 = v_u_7(1, "A string", nil, false)
			local v_u_186 = {}
			local v187 = {}

			end

	describe("Promise.fold", function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_6

			end, 0)

				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1

					return v_u_1.delay(1):andThenReturn(p244 + p245)
				else
					return p244 + p245
				end
			end, 0)
			expect(v_u_1.is(v247)).to.equal(true)
			expect(v247:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)
			v_u_6(2)
			expect(v247:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Resolved)

		end)
		it("should return the first rejected promise", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1

				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1

					return v_u_1.reject("foo")

					return p248 + p249

					return p255 + p256

	describe("Promise.some", function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
		it("should resolve once the goal is reached", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1

			local v_u_307 = nil

					-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_307

		it("should cancel pending Promises once the goal is reached", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v_u_310 = nil
			local v311 = v_u_1.new(function() end)
			local v313 = v_u_1.new(function(p312)
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_310
				v_u_310 = p312
			end)
			local v314 = v_u_1.some({ v311, v313, v_u_1.resolve() }, 2)
			expect(v314:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)
			expect(v311:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)
			expect(v313:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)
			v_u_310()
			expect(v314:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Resolved)

		it("should return an empty array if amount is 0", function()

		describe("Promise.any", function()

			end)

	end)
	describe("Promise.allSettled", function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
		it("should resolve with an array of PromiseStatuses", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v_u_320 = nil

				v_u_1.resolve(),

					-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_320

			expect(v322:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)

function v_u_55.formatErr(p93, p94) -- name: formatErr
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_92, (copy) v_u_6
	local v95 = p94.errs[1]
	local v96
	if v95.message then
		v96 = v95.message:gsub("$input", v_u_92(v95.input))
	else
		v96 = ("expected %*, got %*"):format(v95.type:format(), (v_u_92(v95.input)))
	end
	local v97 = {}
	for v98, v99 in p94.errs do
		if not v99.message and v98 ~= 1 then
			continue
		end
		v97[v99.type] = ("error%*"):format(v98)
	end
	local v100 = ("\n%*\n"):format((p93._format(v97, 80, {})))
	local v101 = {}
	for v102 in v100:gmatch("%$%$error(%d+)%$:") do
		local v103 = tonumber(v102)
		table.insert(v101, v103)
	end
	for v104 = #v101, 1, -1 do
		local v_u_105 = v101[v104]
		local v_u_106 = p94.errs[v_u_105]
		v100 = v100:gsub(("([^\n]*)$$error%*$:(.*):$error%*$$([^\n]*)\n(.*)$"):format(v_u_105, v_u_105), function(p107, p108, p109, p110)
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_6, (copy) v_u_106, (copy) v_u_105
			local v111
			if p108:find("\n", 1, true) == nil then
				v111 = (" "):rep(#p107:gsub("%$%$error%d+%$:", ""):gsub(":%$error%d+%$%$", "")) .. ("^"):rep(#p108)
			else
				local v112 = ("%*%*%*"):format(p107, p108, p109)
				local v113 = 0
				for v114 in string.gmatch(v112, "[^\n]+") do
					if v113 >= #v114 then
						continue
					end
					v113 = #v114
				end
				local v115 = v_u_6(v112)
				v111 = (" "):rep(v115) .. ("^"):rep(v113 - v115)
			end
			if v_u_106.message then
				v111 = ("%* $$error%*$$"):format(v111, v_u_105)
			end
			local v116 = {}
			while true do
				local v117, v118 = p110:match("^([^\n]*)\n(.*)$")
				if not (v117 and (v118 and v117:match("^%s*^"))) then
					break
				end
				table.insert(v116, v117)
				p110 = v118
			end
			if v116[1] then
				return ("%*%*%*\n%*\n%*\n%*"):format(p107, p108, p109, table.concat(v116, "\n"), v111, p110)
			else
				return ("%*%*%*\n%*\n%*"):format(p107, p108, p109, v111, p110)
			end
		end)
	end
	for v119, v120 in p94.errs do
		if not v120.message then
			continue
		end
		local v121 = v120.message:gsub("$input", v_u_92(v120.input))
		v100 = v100:gsub(("%%$%%$error%*%%$%%$"):format(v119), v121)
	end
	return ("%*%*"):format(v96, (v100:gsub("\n(%s*)(^+) ([^\n]+)", function(p122, p123, p124)
		if #p122 + #p123 + #p124 + 1 <= 80 then
			return nil
		else
			return ("\n%*%*\n%*%*"):format(p122, p123, string.rep(" ", #p122), p124)
		end
	end):sub(1, -2)))
end

function v_u_28.literal(p_u_448) -- name: literal
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_36, (copy) v_u_55
	local v_u_449
	if typeof(p_u_448) == "string" then
		v_u_449 = string.format("%q", p_u_448)
	else
		v_u_449 = tostring(p_u_448)
	end
	local v_u_450 = nil
	local v456 = {
		["kind"] = "literal",
		["literal"] = nil,
		["_matches"] = nil,
		["_format"] = nil,
		["literal"] = {
			["value"] = p_u_448
		},
		["_matches"] = function(p451, ...) -- name: _matches
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_448, (ref) v_u_36, (ref) v_u_450, (ref) v_u_449
			if p451 == p_u_448 then
				return v_u_36.ok()
			else
				return v_u_36.err(v_u_450, p451, (("expected literally %*, got $input"):format(v_u_449)))
			end

function v_u_28.withCustom(p460, p_u_461, p_u_462) -- name: withCustom

	end

function v146.IsBalanced(p220) -- name: IsBalanced
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_119

function v146.Check(p227) -- name: Check
	if p227:IsBST() then
		if p227:IsSizeConsistent() then
			if p227:IsRankConsistent() then
				if p227:Is23() then
					if p227:IsBalanced() then
						return true
					else
						return false, "Not balanced"
					end
				else
					return false, "Not a 2-3 tree"
				end
			else
				return false, "Ranks not consistent"
			end
		else
			return false, "Subtree counts not consistent"
		end
	else
		return false, "Not in symmetric order"
	end

	["Storable"] = function(p371, p372) -- name: Storable
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_9, (copy) v_u_396
		if type(p371) == "boolean" then
			return p371
		end
		if type(p371) == "number" then
			return p371
		end
		if type(p371) == "string" then
			if not utf8.len(p371) then
				error("UTF8", 2)
				return p371
			end
		else
			if type(p371) == "buffer" then
				return p371
			end
			if type(p371) == "table" then
				if type(p371) ~= "table" then
					error("table", 2)
				end
				if getmetatable(p371) ~= nil then
					error("metatable", 2)
				end
				local v373 = p372 or {}
				if v373[p371] then
					error("Loop", 2)
				end
				v373[p371] = true
				local v374 = rawlen(p371)
				if v374 <= 0 then
					for v375, v376 in pairs(p371) do
						if type(v375) ~= "string" then
							error(("KeyString $%*"):format((("[%*]"):format((v_u_9(v375))))), 2)
						end
						if not utf8.len(v375) then
							error(("KeyUTF8 $%*"):format((("[%*]"):format((v_u_9(v375))))), 2)
						end
						local v377 = v_u_396.Storable
						local v378, v379 = pcall(v377, v376, v373)
						if v378 then

function v_u_37._collect(p295, p296) -- name: _collect
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3, (ref) v_u_12
	local v_u_297 = {}
	p295.Wanted = v_u_297
	v_u_297[v_u_3] = true

		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_297
		while p298 and (p298:IsA("SoundGroup") and not v_u_297[p298]) do
			v_u_297[p298] = true
			for _, v299 in p298:GetChildren() do
				if not v299:IsA("SoundEffect") then
					continue
				end

		end
	end
	local function v303(p301) -- name: wantSound
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_297, (copy) v_u_300
		v_u_297[p301] = true
		for _, v302 in p301:GetChildren() do
			if not v302:IsA("SoundEffect") then
				continue
			end
			v_u_297[v302] = true
		end
		v_u_300(p301.SoundGroup)
	end
	for v304 in p295.Candidates do
		if p295:_soundAudible(v304) then
			v303(v304)
		else
			if v304.Playing then
				continue
			end
			p295.Candidates[v304] = nil
		end
	end
	for v305, v306 in p295.Ghosts do
		if v306.EndsAt <= p296 then
			p295.Ghosts[v305] = nil
		else
			v303(v305)
		end
	end
	local v307 = p295.ActiveSources
	for v308, v309 in p295.GraphSources do
		if v308:IsDescendantOf(game) then
			local v310 = v_u_12
			local v311, v312 = pcall(v310, v308, v309)
			if v311 then
				v311 = v312 == true
			end
			if v311 == (v307[v308] == true) then
				continue
			end
			v307[v308] = v311 and true or nil
			p295.GraphDirty = true
		else
			p295.GraphSources[v308] = nil
			p295.Seen[v308] = nil
		end
	end
	for v313 in v307 do
		if p295.GraphSources[v313] ~= nil then
			continue
		end
		v307[v313] = nil
		p295.GraphDirty = true
	end
	if p295.GraphDirty or p296 - p295.GraphTime >= 1000 then
		p295.GraphDirty = false
		p295.GraphTime = p296
		if next(v307) or next(p295.Graph) then
			p295:_traceGraph()
		end
	end
	for v314 in p295.Graph do
		v_u_297[v314] = true
	end
end
function v_u_37.Flush(p315) -- name: Flush
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3
	if not p315.Destroyed and (p315.Registry and p315.Enabled) then
		local v316 = p315.Clock()
		p315:_walk(os.clock() + (p315.Walked and 0.0005 or 0.002))
		if #p315.WalkQueue == 0 then
			p315.Walked = true
		end
		p315:_collect(v316)
		local v317 = p315.Wanted
		local v318 = p315.Registry.Ids
		for v319, v320 in table.clone(p315.Nodes) do
			if p315.Nodes[v319] ~= v320 then
				continue
			end
			local v321
			if v320.ParentInst == nil or v318[v320.ParentInst] == v320.ParentId then
				if v320.ParentNode == nil then
					v321 = false
				else
					v321 = p315.Nodes[v320.ParentNode.Inst] ~= v320.ParentNode
				end
			else
				v321 = true
			end
			if v321 then
				p315:_forget(v320)
			else
				local v322 = v317[v319] ~= nil
				if v322 then
					v320.WantedAt = v316
				elseif p315.GraphSources[v319] == nil and (v319 ~= v_u_3 and v320.ClassName ~= "Sound") then
					if v316 - v320.WantedAt < 3000 then
						v322 = v319:IsDescendantOf(game)
					else
						v322 = false
					end
				end
				if v322 then
					if v319:IsA("SoundEffect") or (v319 == v_u_3 or p315.Ghosts[v319]) then
						continue
					end
					local v323, _, _, v324 = p315:_placement(v319, v320.ClassName)
					if v323 == v320.ParentId and v324 == v320.Mode then
						continue
					end
					p315:_remove(v320, v316)
				else
					p315:_remove(v320, v316)
				end
			end
		end
		for v325 in v317 do
			local v326 = p315.Nodes[v325]
			if v326 then
				p315:_poll(v326, v316)
			else
				if v325 == v_u_3 and p315.Nodes[v_u_3] ~= nil then
					continue
				end
				p315:_ensure(v325)
			end
		end
		for v327, v328 in p315.Nodes do
			if v317[v327] or v328.PollTime >= v316 then
				continue
			end
			p315:_poll(v328, v316)
		end

				v354 = p341.Ids[v353]
			end
		else
			v354 = v353
		end
		local v355
		if v354 then
			v355 = p341.SeqStates[v353]
		else
			v355 = v354
		end
		if v355 then
			v355 = v355[p344]
		end
		if v354 and (v355 and v355.Time <= p347) then
			v_u_10.writeCopy(v351, p343, p344, p348, v354)
			v350:EndRecord()
			p341:_setSequence(p342, p344, v352, p347)
			return
		end
	end
	if p348 > 0 then
		v351:u8(v_u_11.PropLerp)
		v_u_7.varuint(v351, p343)
		v_u_7.varuint(v351, p344)
		v351:u8(p348)
	else
		v351:u8(v_u_11.Prop)
		v_u_7.varuint(v351, p343)
		v_u_7.varuint(v351, p344)
	end
	local v356 = #p349
	v351:_ensure(v356)
	buffer.writestring(v351.buf, v351.len, p349)
	v351.len = v351.len + v356
	v350:EndRecord()
	if v352 then
		p341:_setSequence(p342, p344, v352, p347)
	end
end
function v_u_67._flushGroups(p357) -- name: _flushGroups
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_10
	p357.Groups = nil
	local v358 = p357.GroupOrder
	p357.GroupOrder = {}
	local v359 = p357.Stream
	for _, v360 in v358 do
		local v361 = v360.Members
		local v362 = v360.PropId
		local v363 = v360.Type
		local v364 = v360.T
		if #v361 == 1 then
			local v365 = v361[1]
			p357:_writeSingle(v365.Inst, v365.Id, v362, v363, v360.Value, v364, v360.LerpUnits, v360.Encoded)
		else
			table.sort(v361, function(p366, p367)
				return p366.Id < p367.Id
			end)
			v359:Time(v364)
			local v368 = v359.W
			v368:u8(v_u_11.PropMany)
			v_u_7.varuint(v368, v362)
			v368:u8(v360.LerpUnits)
			v_u_7.varuint(v368, #v361)
			local v369 = 0
			for _, v370 in v361 do
				v_u_7.varuint(v368, v370.Id - v369)
				v369 = v370.Id
			end
			local v371 = v360.Encoded
			local v372 = #v371
			v368:_ensure(v372)
			buffer.writestring(v368.buf, v368.len, v371)
			v368.len = v368.len + v372
			v359:EndRecord()
			if not v_u_10.Types[v363] then
				break
			end
			local v373 = v360.Value
			local v374 = ("%*:%*"):format(v362, (v_u_10.key(v_u_10.keypoints(v363, v373))))
			for _, v375 in v361 do
				p357:_setSequence(v375.Inst, v362, v374, v364)
			end
		end
	end
end
function v_u_67._writeMotion(p376, p377, p378, p379, p380, p381) -- name: _writeMotion
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_9, (copy) v_u_7
	p376.Sampled[p377] = true
	local v382 = p376.Samples[p377]
	local v383
	if v382 then
		v383 = v382.T
	else
		v383 = v382
	end
	local v384
	if v382 then
		v384 = v382.CFrame
	else
		v384 = v382
	end
	local v385
	if v382 then
		v385 = v382.BeforeT
	else
		v385 = v382
	end
	local v386
	if v382 then
		v386 = v382.Before
	else
		v386 = v382
	end
	if v382 then
		local v387 = v382.T
		local v388 = v382.CFrame
		v382.BeforeT = v387
		v382.Before = v388
		v382.T = p381
		v382.CFrame = p380
	else
		p376.Samples[p377] = {
			["T"] = p381,
			["CFrame"] = p380
		}
	end
	local v389 = p376.Motions[p377]
	local v390
	if v389 then
		local v391
		if p381 < v389.T then
			v391 = false
		else
			local v392 = v_u_9.at(v389.Base, v389.W, v389.V, v389.A, (p381 - v389.T) / 1000)
			v391 = not v_u_9.apart(v392, p380, 0.2, 0.02)
		end
		if v391 then
			v389.Hits = v389.Hits + 1
			return true, false
		end
		p376.Motions[p377] = nil
		v390 = true
		if v389.Hits == 0 then
			p376.Untrusted[p377] = true
		end
	else
		v390 = false
	end
	if not v384 or (not v383 or (p381 <= v383 or p381 - v383 > 250)) then
		p376.Candidates[p377] = nil
		return false, v390
	end
	local v393, v394 = v_u_9.between(v384, p380, (p381 - v383) / 1000)
	local v395 = v393.Magnitude < 0.002 and Vector3.new(0, 0, 0) or v393
	if v394.Magnitude < 0.02 and v395 == Vector3.new(0, 0, 0) then
		p376.Candidates[p377] = nil
		return false, v390
	end
	local v396 = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	local v397, v398
	if v395 == Vector3.new(0, 0, 0) and (v386 and (v385 and (v385 < v383 and v383 - v385 <= 250))) then
		v397, v398 = v_u_9.accelerating(v386.Position, v384.Position, p380.Position, v385 / 1000, v383 / 1000, p381 / 1000)
		if v398.Magnitude < 0.05 then
			v398 = v396
			v397 = v394
		end
	else
		v398 = v396
		v397 = v394
	end
	local v399 = {
		["PropId"] = nil,
		["T"] = nil,
		["Base"] = nil,
		["W"] = nil,
		["V"] = nil,
		["A"] = nil,
		["Hits"] = 0,
		["PropId"] = p379,
		["T"] = p381,
		["Base"] = p380,
		["W"] = v395,
		["V"] = v397,
		["A"] = v398
	}
	local v400
	if not p376.Untrusted[p377] then
		p376.Motions[p377] = v399
		v404, v405, v406, v407 = v_u_7.quantizeRotation(p380)
		v408 = p376.SentCFrames[p377]
		if not v408 then
			v408 = {}
			p376.SentCFrames[p377] = v408
		end
		v409 = v408[p379]
		if v409 == nil or (v409.K ~= v404 or (v409.A ~= v405 or v409.B ~= v406)) then
			v400 = false
		else
			v400 = v409.C == v407
		end
		v408[p379] = {
			["Position"] = p380.Position,
			["K"] = v404,
			["A"] = v405,
			["B"] = v406,
			["C"] = v407
		}
		v410 = p376.Stream
		v410:Time(p381)
		v_u_9.write(v410.W, p378, p379, p380, v395, v397, v398, v400)
		v410:EndRecord()
		v411 = p376.LastSent[p377]
		if v411 then
			v411[p379] = p381
		end
		return true, v390
	end
	local v401 = p376.Candidates[p377]
	p376.Candidates[p377] = v399
	if not v401 then
		return false, v390
	end
	local v402
	if p381 < v401.T then
		v402 = false
	else
		local v403 = v_u_9.at(v401.Base, v401.W, v401.V, v401.A, (p381 - v401.T) / 1000)
		v402 = not v_u_9.apart(v403, p380, 0.2, 0.02)
	end
	if not v402 then
		return false, v390
	end
	p376.Untrusted[p377] = nil
	p376.Candidates[p377] = nil
	p376.Motions[p377] = v399
	local v404, v405, v406, v407 = v_u_7.quantizeRotation(p380)
	local v408 = p376.SentCFrames[p377]
	if not v408 then
		v408 = {}
		p376.SentCFrames[p377] = v408
	end
	local v409 = v408[p379]
	if v409 == nil or (v409.K ~= v404 or (v409.A ~= v405 or v409.B ~= v406)) then
		v400 = false
	else
		v400 = v409.C == v407
	end
	v408[p379] = {
		["Position"] = p380.Position,
		["K"] = v404,
		["A"] = v405,
		["B"] = v406,
		["C"] = v407
	}
	local v410 = p376.Stream
	v410:Time(p381)
	v_u_9.write(v410.W, p378, p379, p380, v395, v397, v398, v400)
	v410:EndRecord()
	local v411 = p376.LastSent[p377]
	if v411 then
		v411[p379] = p381
	end
	return true, v390
end
function v_u_67._checkMotions(p412) -- name: _checkMotions
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_28
	local v413 = p412.Clock()
	local v414 = {}
	for v415 in p412.Motions do
		if p412.Sampled[v415] then
			continue
		end
		table.insert(v414, v415)
	end
	for _, v416 in v414 do
		local v417 = p412.Motions[v416]
		local v418 = p412.Ids[v416]
		if v418 then
			local v419 = v_u_28(v416, "CFrame")
			p412.LastCFrame[v416] = v419
			p412:_writeProp(v416, v418, v417.PropId, v419, v413)
		else
			p412.Motions[v416] = nil
		end
	end
	table.clear(p412.Sampled)
end

function v_u_67._untrack(p424, p425) -- name: _untrack
	local v426 = p424.Kinds[p425]
	if v426 == "joint" or (v426 == "weld" or v426 == "constraint") then
		local v427 = p424.JointParts[p425]
		if v427 then
			p424:_checkRoots(v427[1], v427[2], p424.Clock())
		end
		p424:_setJointParts(p425, nil, nil)
	end
	if p424.Ids[p425] then
		p424.Count = p424.Count - 1
	end
	p424.Registry:Free(p425)
	p424.Registry:NotifyUntracked(p425)
	p424.Kinds[p425] = nil
	p424.Roots[p425] = nil
	p424.RootOf[p425] = nil
	p424.JointParts[p425] = nil
	p424.Held[p425] = nil
	p424.InCharacter[p425] = nil
	p424.Baked[p425] = nil
	p424.BakedMemo[p425] = nil
	p424.LastCFrame[p425] = nil
	p424.LastSent[p425] = nil
	p424.SeqStates[p425] = nil
	p424.SentCFrames[p425] = nil
	p424.Motions[p425] = nil
	p424.Samples[p425] = nil
	p424.Candidates[p425] = nil
	p424.Untrusted[p425] = nil
	p424.WorldPoll.Set[p425] = nil
	p424:_setPlayerPolled(p425, nil)
	p424.DirtyProps[p425] = nil
	p424.DirtyName[p425] = nil
	for _, v428 in { p424.Signals, p424.AttachSignals } do
		local v429 = v428[p425]
		if not v429 then
			continue
		end
		for _, v430 in v429 do
			v430:Disconnect()
		end
		v428[p425] = nil
	end
end
function v_u_67._untrackTree(p431, p432, p433) -- name: _untrackTree
	local v434
	if p433 then
		local v435 = p431.Kids[p433]
		if v435 then
			v435[p432] = nil
			v434 = { p432 }
		else
			v434 = { p432 }
		end
	else
		v434 = { p432 }
	end
	while #v434 > 0 do
		local v436 = table.remove(v434)
		local v437 = p431.Kids[v436]
		if v437 then
			for v438 in v437 do
				table.insert(v434, v438)
			end
			p431.Kids[v436] = nil
		end
		p431:_untrack(v436)
	end
end
function v_u_67._watchFiltered(p_u_439, p_u_440) -- name: _watchFiltered
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_66
	p_u_439.Registry:WatchFiltered(p_u_440, function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_439, (copy) p_u_440, (ref) v_u_66
		if not p_u_439.Destroyed then
			local v441 = p_u_439.Clock()
			p_u_439.DirtyStructure[p_u_440] = v441
			for _, v442 in p_u_440:GetDescendants() do
				if not v_u_66(v442) then
					continue
				end
				p_u_439.DirtyStructure[v442] = v441
			end
		end
	end)
end
function v_u_67._discover(p443, p444, p445) -- name: _discover
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_66, (ref) v_u_28
	local v446 = v_u_66(p444)
	if v446 == "gui" then
		if not p443:_inBaked(v_u_28(p444, "Parent")) then
			p443.TrackGui(p444)
			return
		end
	else
		if v446 == "baked" and not p443.BakeModels then
			return
		end
		if v446 or p443.Particles[p444] then
			p443:_track(p444, p445)
		end
	end
end
function v_u_67._mark(p447, p448) -- name: _mark
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_66, (ref) v_u_28
	local v449 = p448:IsA("Animator")
	if (v449 or v_u_66(p448)) and not p447:_hiddenByBake(p448, v_u_28(p448, "Parent")) then
		if v449 then
			p447.WatchAnimator(p448)
		else
			p447.DirtyStructure[p448] = p447.Clock()
		end
	else
		return
	end
end
function v_u_67._walk(p450, p451) -- name: _walk
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_28
	local v452 = p450.Registry
	local v453 = p450.Pending
	while #v453 > 0 do
		if p451 <= os.clock() then
			return false
		end
		local v454 = table.remove(v453)
		local v455 = v_u_28(v454, "Parent")
		if v455 == nil then
			continue
		end
		if v452:MatchFilter(v454, v455) then
			p450:_watchFiltered(v454)
		else
			p450:_discover(v454, p450.Clock())
			if v454:IsA("Animator") then
				p450.WatchAnimator(v454)
			end
			if v454:IsA("BillboardGui") or v454:IsA("SurfaceGui") or p450:_inBaked(v454) then
				continue
			end
			for _, v456 in v454:GetChildren() do
				table.insert(v453, v456)
			end
		end
	end
	return true
end
function v_u_67._scope(p_u_457, p458) -- name: _scope
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_40
	local v459 = v_u_40()
	if p_u_457.Scoped then
		local v460 = v459.Connections
		local v461 = p458.DescendantAdded
		table.insert(v460, v461:Connect(function(p462)
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_457
			p_u_457:_mark(p462)
		end))
	end
	local v463 = p_u_457.Pending
	table.insert(v463, p458)
	return v459
end
local function v_u_471(p464, p465, p466) -- name: closeWatch
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_471
	local v467 = p465[p466]
	if v467 then
		p465[p466] = nil
		for _, v468 in v467.Connections do
			v468:Disconnect()
		end
		for _, v469 in v467.Names do
			v469:Disconnect()
		end

		end
	end
end
function v_u_67._watchPath(p_u_472, p473, p_u_474) -- name: _watchPath
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_40, (copy) v_u_471, (ref) v_u_28
	if next(p_u_474.Children) ~= nil then
		local v_u_475 = v_u_40()
		p_u_472.Watches[p473] = v_u_475
		local function v_u_478(p476) -- name: check
			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_475, (ref) v_u_471, (copy) p_u_472, (copy) p_u_474, (ref) v_u_28
			if v_u_475.Kids[p476] then
				v_u_475.Kids[p476] = nil
				v_u_471(p_u_472, p_u_472.Watches, p476)
			end
			local v477 = p_u_474.Children[v_u_28(p476, "Name")]
			if v477 == nil or p_u_472.Destroyed then
				return
			else
				v_u_475.Kids[p476] = true
				if v477.Marked then
					p_u_472.Watches[p476] = p_u_472:_scope(p476)
				else
					p_u_472:_watchPath(p476, v477)
				end
			end
		end
		local function v480(p_u_479) -- name: added
			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_475, (copy) v_u_478
			if not v_u_475.Names[p_u_479] then
				v_u_475.Names[p_u_479] = p_u_479:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Name"):Connect(function()
					-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_478, (copy) p_u_479
					v_u_478(p_u_479)
				end)
				v_u_478(p_u_479)
			end
		end
		local v481 = v_u_475.Connections
		local v482 = p473.ChildAdded
		table.insert(v481, v482:Connect(v480))
		local v483 = v_u_475.Connections
		local v484 = p473.ChildRemoved
		local function v487(p485)
			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_475, (ref) v_u_471, (copy) p_u_472
			local v486 = v_u_475.Names[p485]
			if v486 then
				v486:Disconnect()
				v_u_475.Names[p485] = nil
			end
			if v_u_475.Kids[p485] then
				v_u_475.Kids[p485] = nil
				v_u_471(p_u_472, p_u_472.Watches, p485)
			end
		end
		table.insert(v483, v484:Connect(v487))
		for _, v488 in p473:GetChildren() do
			v480(v488)
		end
	end
end

function v_u_67._watchBaked(p_u_519) -- name: _watchBaked
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_17, (copy) v_u_63
	local v520 = p_u_519.Connections
	local v521 = v_u_1:GetInstanceAddedSignal(v_u_17)
	local function v523(p522)

		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_519

	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_24, (copy) v_u_25, (copy) v_u_8

	local v71 = v_u_25.Wheel.WheelTemplates

		local v81 = v73.AbsoluteSize
